name: Zadok
bio:
Zadok son of Ahitub served as one of David's priests, listed here alongside the royal officials of David's growing administration (2 Samuel 8:17).

When Absalom's rebellion forced David to flee Jerusalem, Zadok and the Levites carried the ark of the covenant out of the city with him, but David sent them back, trusting God rather than the ark itself to decide his fate: "If I find favor in the LORD's eyes, he will bring me back... But if he says, 'I am not pleased with you,' then I am ready; let him do to me whatever seems good to him" (2 Samuel 15:24-26). David asked Zadok to return to the city with his son Ahimaaz, ready to relay to David anything that could be learned there of Absalom's plans (2 Samuel 15:27-29). After Hushai's counsel defeated Ahithophel's advice to pursue David at once, Hushai brought word to Zadok and Abiathar, who sent their sons Ahimaaz and Jonathan to warn David to cross the Jordan immediately (2 Samuel 17:15-22). Zadok's continued loyalty to David during the rebellion and his role in Solomon's succession are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
